name: USB device insertion forensics with Windows Registry shellbags and shimcache
topic: USB device insertion forensics with Windows Registry shellbags and shimcache
description: USB device insertion forensics with Windows Registry shellbags and shimcache -- a hard-tier forensics challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "USB device insertion forensics with Windows Registry shellbags and shimcache"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is a double layer: hex -> base64 -> XOR. Unwind both layers and recover the 4-byte XOR key.
